description: Towards a peer recorded Ed4, a first ARQ segment too long for the configured transmission length is cut to end where the length's room ends, marker included, rather than stretching the transmission for it.
note: As dts-tx-block-align-ed4 up to its data transmission, with modem.eom_bytes 4, dts.max_segment_size 100 (C-0503), dts.max_transmission_ms 5550 (one block: 600 + 4800 + 150) and a 100-byte U_PDU, the template's 44 letters followed by 'STUVWXYZ0123456789' and the letters again to 'L' (S_UNIDATA_REQUEST length 112, U_PDU length 100). 40-byte blocks carry 36 bytes once the marker has its room, and a burst of m bytes takes ceil((m + 4) / 40) blocks (corpus-format.md 5; interp C-1290). Everything before 108000 is unchanged: the U_PDU's length changes no earlier output, and the 25-byte request needs one block. The C_PDU is 106 bytes (6 of C_PCI and DATA S_PDU header, then the U_PDU). At 108000 the first segment at the maximum segment size, 100 bytes, is a 119-byte DATA-ONLY, which would need ceil(123 / 40) = 4 blocks. Towards a peer recorded Ed4 any segment may be shorter than the maximum (C-0553), so the limit blocks nothing (C-0551, C-0878) and the transmission is not stretched for it: it is cut to end where the configured length's room ends, 36 bytes, a 17-byte segment (interp C-1042, C-1155, C-1290; the space-filling use of short segments, C-0887). FSN 0, C_PDU START, TX WIN UWE and TX WIN LWE, since it is the only FSN allocated (C-0176, C-0185, C-0186, C-1122), DELIVER IN ORDER as the SIS asked, EOW CAPABILITY (C-1260), EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043). No room is left for fill (C-1154). The transmission lasts 5550 ms, the limit, and ends at 113550, when dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts with dts.ack_wait_ms 60000; the other 89 bytes of the C_PDU are still queued, so csma.lbt_wait starts with lbt_wait_vdcd_ms 3000 after the own transmission (K-0074). Before corpus 0.32.0 the transmission was stretched to the 4 blocks and the segment cut to the last room end it passed, 116 bytes (a 97-byte segment), so 3 blocks and 15150 ms against a 5550 ms limit.
